questions.question: The pattern is: red, blue, red, blue. What letters show the same pattern?
options: A B A B
A B C D
A A B B
A B A
questions.explain: Red and blue keep switching, so we use the same two letters over and over: A B A B. The trap is giving every spot a brand-new letter, like A B C D.

questions.question: The pattern is: clap, stomp, stomp, clap, stomp, stomp. What letters show the same pattern?
options: A B C A B C
A B B A B B
A B A B A B
A A B A A B
questions.explain: One clap and two stomps repeat, so the letters are A B B. The trap is making all three spots different, like A B C.

questions.question: The pattern is: jump, jump, spin, jump, jump, spin. What letters show the same pattern?
options: A B C A B C
A B A B A B
A A B A A B
A B B A B B
questions.explain: Two jumps and one spin repeat, so the letters are A A B. The trap is moving the two same letters to a different spot, like A B B.

questions.question: Letters A A B show a repeating pattern. What 3 shapes match?
options: circle, star, star
circle, star, square
star, circle, star
circle, circle, star
questions.explain: A A B means two of one and one of another, so two circles and one star fit. The trap is putting the two same shapes in the wrong spot.

questions.question: Mia does: clap, clap, stomp, clap, clap, stomp. She wants to show the pattern with letters. Which is right?
options: A A B A A B
A B C A B C
A B B A B B
A B A B A B
questions.explain: Two claps and one stomp repeat, so the letters are A A B. The trap is giving each beat a new letter, like A B C.

questions.question: Tom lines up his shapes: circle, star, circle, star. He wants to write the pattern with letters. Which one is right?
options: A B C D
A B A B
A A B B
A B A
questions.explain: Circle and star keep switching, so the letters are A B A B. The trap is giving each shape a brand-new letter, like A B C D.

questions.question: At circle time, kids do: hop, spin, hop, spin. The teacher wants to show the pattern with letters. Which is right?
options: A B C D
A A B B
A B A B
A B A
questions.explain: Hop and spin keep switching, so the letters are A B A B. The trap is making the two same letters stick together, like A A B B.

questions.question: Lily taps a drum: boom, tick, tick, boom, tick, tick. She writes letters to show the pattern. Which is right?
options: A B C A B C
A B A B A B
A A B A A B
A B B A B B
questions.explain: One boom and two ticks repeat, so the letters are A B B. The trap is making all three spots different, like A B C.

questions.question: Sam's pattern is: red, red, blue, red, red, blue. He says: I can show it with letters A B C A B C. What went wrong?
options: He gave a new letter to each beat.
He moved where the two same go.
He made every beat look the same.
He used letters in the wrong order.
questions.explain: Red, red, blue has two of one and one of another, so the letters should be A A B, not A B C. Giving every beat a new letter is the most common mix-up here.

questions.question: Mia's pattern is: clap, stomp, stomp, clap, stomp, stomp. She writes it as: A B B A B B. Which sounds match her letters?
options: boom, tick, boom, tick, boom, tick
boom, tick, tick, boom, tick, tick
boom, boom, tick, boom, boom, tick
boom, tick, clang, boom, tick, clang
questions.explain: A B B means one sound and then two of another, so boom, tick, tick fits. The trap is using three different sounds, like boom, tick, clang.

questions.question: Leo's pattern is: jump, jump, jump, spin, jump, jump, jump, spin. He writes it as: A A A B A A A B. Which shapes match the first group?
options: dot, star, star, star
dot, star, ring, square
dot, dot, dot, star
dot, dot, star, star
questions.explain: A A A B means three of one and one of another, so three dots and one star fit. The trap is giving all four spots a different shape, like dot, star, ring, square.

questions.question: Mia has 6 beads: red, blue, blue, red, blue, blue. She wants to show the pattern with letters and with sounds. Which pair is right?
options: A B A A B A and ding, dong, ding, ding, dong, ding
A B A B A B and ding, dong, ding, dong, ding, ding
A B C A B C and ding, dong, clank, ding, dong, clank
A B B A B B and ding, dong, dong, ding, dong, dong
questions.explain: One red and two blue repeat, so the core is A B B and the sounds should be one ding and two dongs. The trap is giving every bead a new letter or a new sound.
